title: Matching Question Schema
description: Match items to their corresponding match (1:1 pairs) or classify items into categories (many-to-one). The matchingMode discriminator selects the sub-shape.

matchingMode.description: Selects the matching sub-shape. 'pairs' for 1:1 matching (each item has one correct match); 'classification' for many-to-one (each item belongs to one category, multiple items may share a category).

distractors.description: Extra match values (pairs mode) or category labels (classification mode) that don't belong to any item. The choice pool a consumer presents to a learner is the union of authored match values (or category labels) and these distractors; consumers MUST randomise the order of that pool when rendering — see NORMATIVE §5.6.

allowPartialCredit.description: Award partial credit per correct row instead of all-or-nothing.

pairs.description: Each entry is one item-and-match row.

categories.description: Each entry is one category with its label and items belonging to it. The order in which items render to a learner is consumer-defined; consumers MUST randomise the row order at render time so that the source-JSON category grouping does not expose the answer (NORMATIVE §5.6).
